To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
Pd-Ni/ PPy/GC electrode modified with polypyrrole(Ppy)film can improve the catalytic activity for electrochemical reductive declorination of 4-chlorophenol(CPh).
the Pd-Ni/ PPy/GC electrode has higher hydrogen adsorption ability and better catalytic activity than the Pd-Nic/GC electrode.

the hydrogen adsorptive capacity of Pd-Nicarbon composite electrode was improved significantly after modification with PPy film, and the Pd-Ni/ PPy/GC electrode has a good prospect of application in electrochemical reduction of chlorinated organic compounds.
